diagnosis: Potential initialization race: setDocument emits loadImage through the JavaScript bridge before evaluateJavascript returns. Android previously accepted bridge messages only after that return callback set loadedRevision, which could discard initial image requests. This is consistent with missing images and PDF preparation failing on notes with image references; device reproduction remains necessary.
change: Mark the expected editor revision active before calling setDocument. If initialization reports an error, clear that revision and show the existing visual-editor error. The image-source fallback mapping from dev.58 remains in place.
